model.family: multioutput linear-kernel Ridge on training-centered drug-specific DSS residuals
model.inner_cv: deterministic 5-fold patient split within each outer-training set
model.inner_selection_objective: patient-balanced mean squared error across the complete 24-drug residual profile
model.selection_tie_break: minimum MSE, then smaller k, then larger alpha

bootstrap.threshold_range: 5th to 95th percentile among numerically defined patient-profile bootstrap draws
bootstrap.nonpositive_denominator_rule: exclude the metric threshold from that draw and report the count; joint threshold requires both positive denominators

saturation.plateau_reference: componentwise maximum of FULL_RNA_REOPT and PCA_STAR_DENSE
saturation.strong_early_gain_rule: PCA16 minus PCA2 >= the frozen practical scale for both PG and g_func
saturation.late_gain_rule: PCA32 minus PCA16 is below the frozen practical scale for both metrics and no adjacent positive late gain reaches its practical scale
saturation.random_structure_rule: PCA exceeds the 95th percentile of matched random projections for both PG and g_func at at least two of k=16,24,32

random_control.construction: one shared set of 100 outcome-blind 32-column gene-space orthonormal bases; each fixed-k control uses the first k columns

optional_tail_pc_control: NOT_EXECUTED: a strict 32-dimensional lower-variance block is not uniformly available within approximately 40-patient inner-training ranks
claim_boundary: Operational finite-sample predictive representation resolution; PCA still requires full baseline RNA measurement and is not an assay or information-theoretic dimension claim.
